content.explanation: Expand: $(2x - 5)^2 = 4x^2 - 20x + 25$. Subtracting $(x^2 - 25)$ means subtracting $x^2$ and adding $25$: $4x^2 - 20x + 25 - x^2 + 25 = 3x^2 - 20x + 50$.

distractorRationales.label: B
distractorRationales.text: This subtracts 25 instead of adding it when distributing the minus sign.

distractorRationales.label: C
distractorRationales.text: This squares $2x - 5$ as $4x^2 + 25$, leaving out the middle term $-20x$.

distractorRationales.label: D
distractorRationales.text: This uses $-10x$ as the middle term, forgetting to double $2x \cdot 5$.
